crossRefs.note: Your vows are on me, God. I will give thank offerings to you.
crossRefs.keyword: she vowed. Heb. her vows were upon her

translations.web: “If she has a husband, while her vows are on her, or the rash utterance of her lips with which she has bound her soul,
translations.bsb: If a woman marries while under a vow or rash promise by which she has bound herself,
translations.kjv: And if she had at all an husband, when she vowed, or uttered ought out of her lips, wherewith she bound her soul;
translations.asv: And if she be married to a husband, while her vows are upon her, or the rash utterance of her lips, wherewith she hath bound her soul,
